ideas.pitch: Multilingual autonomous health agent for rural clinics that diagnoses preliminary symptoms, checks local vaccine stocks, and auto-generates outbreak alert reports for district authorities.
ideas.problem_statement: Rural health awareness and automated district health reporting across Bharat languages.
ideas.title: ArogyaDoot Bharat
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly echoes the winning SAGACITY pattern by combining vernacular accessibility with critical health utility, appealing heavily to GovTech and HealthTech judges.

ideas.pitch: Autonomous multi-step agricultural procurement agent that analyzes regional soil data, plans fertilizer application schedules, and coordinates directly with local cooperative supply chains.
ideas.problem_statement: AgriTech supply chain inefficiencies and lack of actionable, localized farming advice.
ideas.title: KrishiKosh Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features true multi-step planning and tool usage over simple wrapper text, fulfilling strict project requirements while targeting AgriTech.

ideas.pitch: An agentic navigator for rural welfare schemes that verifies citizen eligibility across 50+ government portals via voice in regional Indian languages and submits applications automatically.
ideas.problem_statement: Low scheme utilization and complex paperwork in GovTech across Bharat languages.
ideas.title: BhashaGov Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a painful administrative problem familiar to judges living in India, with high measurable socio-economic impact.

ideas.pitch: Adaptive AI teaching assistant agent that generates personalized regional-language remediation modules for rural students based on diagnostic quiz telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: EdTech access gaps and personalization challenges in vernacular Indian classrooms.
ideas.title: ShikshaSutra
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines EdTech and Bharat Languages tracks into a tightly scoped, working prototype with a clear pedagogical feedback loop.

ideas.pitch: Voice-first desktop agent for senior citizens in India that actively intercepts and analyzes suspicious financial UPI requests and fraudulent phishing calls in real time.
ideas.problem_statement: FinTech cyber fraud targeting vulnerable and elderly demographics across India.
ideas.title: VridhGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a proven global hackathon winner concept to the Indian FinTech and UPI ecosystem, demonstrating sophisticated event-driven agent workflows.
